QuestInfo.name: Olly Olly Oxen Free
QuestInfo.0: Smartie is yelling, 'Olly olly oxen free' and none of his friends are coming out.
QuestInfo.1: Smartie says he cannot finish the game because his friends don't come out when he yells, 'Olly olly oxen free!' Go find Smartie's friends who are hiding in various places in Edelstein.
QuestInfo.2: You found all of Smartie's friends who were hiding in various places in Edelstein.

speech.0: Did Smartie give up? I knew he'd never be able to find me here!\r\n
I'm glad the game's over. I want to go home and eat! I'm starving!\r\n
Smartie's the worst at Hide-and-Seek. I was just munching on candy the whole time.

0.0: Heh. Heh. My friends and I are playing Hide-and-Seek, but everyone's hidden so well that I can't find a single one of them! I called the game off, but everyone is still hiding!
0.1: The rule was to stay in town, so they should all be around somewhere. Can you let them know the game's over? I'm going home!

1.0: I-I'm not Von. W-what are you talking about?
1.1: Huh? Smartie said he's done playing? I didn't hear it...\r\n

yes.0: Boooring! Smartie's always It and he's never found me, not once. Tag would be more fun than Hide-and-Seek.
